construction.base_displacement: object world XY minus robot root world XY
construction.gripper_opening: 0=closed upper joint limit, 1=open lower joint limit
construction.heading_offset: unsigned horizontal angle between robot forward and Level02 object motion, degrees
construction.heading_sampling: motion yaw +/- sampled angle; choose the side nearer the bearing to object
construction.motion_heading_constraint: robot forward XY dot Level02 object-motion XY > 0; motion includes rotated local table velocity and enabled yaw tangential velocity
construction.object_yaw: world-z rotation * normal-reset object quaternion; offline construction only
construction.pregrasp_orientation: candidate quaternion * local roll-pitch-yaw delta quaternion
construction.pregrasp_position: candidate local [-sqrt(d*d-y*y-z*z), y, z]; d is Euclidean distance
construction.sampling: uniform geometry targets followed by IK and basic physics filtering

collision_check.method: every-frame joint limits/contact forces, peak object displacement, final support

physical_validation.near_goal_contact_check: both finger net contact forces, object between finger surfaces, collision mesh above table
physical_validation.table_control: nominal support pose held each tick; Level02 motion resumes at training reset

validation_by_family.near_goal: physical close/lift/hold and cold-reset grip verification

notes.coverage: Distributions of actual stored states, not the configured target ranges.
notes.first_rejection_counts: Mutually exclusive first failed check in check_order; totals equal invalid.
notes.histograms: Ten bins across observed values; constant values use a small display interval.
notes.rejection_counts: Independent failed checks; one proposal may be counted more than once.
notes.stored: A valid proposal actually selected for the saved bank.
notes.valid: A proposal passing all checks before the family quota is applied.
